a: Every commit message MUST carry a body that lists each changed file.
b: A commit message MUST be one subject line with no body.

a: Write every test name in snake_case so the runner output reads as prose.
b: Test names MUST use camelCase, the same as every other function.

a: Always run the linter in the foreground, so its output lands in the reply.
b: Never run a lint command in the foreground; start it in the background.

a: Write every chat reply to the user in German.
b: Every reply to the user MUST be in English.

a: Put each shared helper function in a file named utils.go.
b: Never name a file utils, helpers or common; name it after its concept.

a: An error message MUST start with a capital letter and end with a period.
b: An error message MUST NOT start with a capital letter or end with punctuation.

a: A subagent prompt MUST include the full conversation history.
b: Never pass the conversation history into a subagent prompt; write a self-contained brief.

a: Wrap each markdown paragraph at 80 columns.
b: Do not add a line break inside one markdown paragraph.

a: Every TODO note title MUST start with its ticket id.
b: A TODO note title MUST NOT carry a ticket id.

a: Use `git add -A` before every commit, so no file is left out.
b: Never stage with `git add -A`; add each file by its name.
